title: Transport Agreement — Sagar Roadlines
parties: BlueFin Commerce ("the Customer") and Sagar Roadlines ("the Carrier")
service: regional surface transport, West Bengal and adjoining districts

clauses.text: Freight per consignment is the sum of: - a weight component of ₹6.00 per kg of billed weight, and - a distance component of ₹2.00 per km of the booked lane distance.
Only standard service is offered under this agreement.
Consignments booked as cold chain travel in refrigerated vehicles and carry a premium of 20% on the freight charge (the sum of the weight and distance components).
The Carrier invoices as trips are pooled, typically fortnightly. Payment is due 21 days from invoice date.

The consignment note (c-note) number quoted on each invoice line is the Carrier's reference and must correspond to a Customer booking. Lines that cannot be matched to a booking are not payable until reconciled.
The Carrier may issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices. A credit note references the original c-note number and the invoice it corrects, and must cover the full corrected amount.
